1.0.1.en: First release with store compliant readme.

2.0.0.en: Added last trip distance and duration. Added relocation alarm. Added offline alarm. Added many flow triggers. Fixed range value.

2.0.1.en: Added alarm icons. Improved last parked detection. Changed default offline alarm time to 9 hours.

2.0.3.en: Last parked is only updated on >250m displacement or odo change. Wait extra for incoming odo change.

3.0.0.en: API rewrite. Fixed concurrent use with native Cowboy app.

4.0.0.en: Major upgrade. Added capabilities, widgets and flows. Added translations. Improved stability.

4.1.0.en: Added Cowboy Cross, Cruiser & C4 model images and ride mode support. Enhanced widgets with trip duration and live ride status. Added JSON info flow card. Improved stability.
